note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: The 1962 typical edition (p. 648) prints qui: the fire is the subject of inflammávit and Cor its object. The pinned digital proper has cui, which leaves the relative clause without a subject. The selected reading is attested by the controlling witness.
The typical edition's punctuation is retained. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.
